description:
Counter an existing offer with a new proposed price.

Submits a counter-offer linked to a parent trade. The active wallet signs the
counter with BIP-137 to prove identity. Either party in a trade may counter.

Requires an unlocked wallet with Bitcoin keys.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

inscription_id.description: Inscription ID (must match the parent trade)

parent_trade_id.description: ID of the trade being countered

name: ordinals_p2p_counter
